caption: The drawing depicts a chest with a domed, scalloped lid and is shown resting on four clawed feet. The main color of the chest is a dark greenish-brown, with lighter brown highlights that suggest reflections or worn areas. The lid is divided into three raised sections and has a metal handle in the center, which is ornate and colored in a brassy gold. There is a horizontal band that wraps around the chest below the lid as well as at the base; these bands are decorated in shades of gold and are patterned with vertical red and orange marks. The lock on the front of the chest is heart-shaped and prominently colored in gold, matching the bands and the handle. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no other objects present. The artist's signature and the year "'40" are inscribed in the bottom right corner in small letters.
title: Tea Caddy
